questions.text_english: If P(A ∪ B) = 0·9 and P(A ∩ B) = 0·4, then P(Ā) + P(B̅) is :
questions.solution: We know P(Ā) + P(B̅) = (1 - P(A)) + (1 - P(B)) = 2 - [P(A) + P(B)]. Using the addition rule, P(A) + P(B) = P(A∪B) + P(A∩B) = 0.9 + 0.4 = 1.3. Therefore P(Ā) + P(B̅) = 2 - 1.3 = 0.7. Option (D) is correct.

questions.solution: For continuity at x = 0, lim(x→0) f(x) must equal f(0) = 1. We compute lim(x→0) sin²(ax)/x² = lim(x→0) [sin(ax)/(ax)]^2 · a² = 1² · a² = a². For continuity, a² = 1, giving a = ±1. Option (C) is correct. Option (D) a = 0 would give the limit as 0 ≠ 1.

questions.solution: A singular matrix has determinant equal to zero. Determinant = 3(4+x) - (-2)(x-1) = 12 + 3x + 2x - 2 = 10 + 5x. Setting this to zero: 10 + 5x = 0, so x = -2. Option (C) is correct. The other values of x yield a non-zero determinant, making the matrix non-singular.

questions.text: वक्र y = -x³ + 3x² + 8x - 20 की प्रवणता जिस बिंदु पर अधिकतम है, वह है :

questions.solution: Slope = dy/dx = -3x² + 6x + 8. To maximize slope, differentiate again: d/dx(-3x² + 6x + 8) = -6x + 6 = 0, giving x = 1. Second derivative of slope = -6 < 0, confirming maximum. At x = 1: y = -1 + 3 + 8 - 20 = -10. So slope is maximum at point (1, -10). Wait — re-checking: y(1) = -(1) + 3(1) + 8(1) - 20 = -1 + 3 + 8 - 20 = -10. The point is (1, -10), but option (B) says (1, 10). Let me recheck: -1 + 3 + 8 - 20 = -10. So the correct point is (1, -10), which is option (A). The correct answer is (A).

questions.text: ∫√(1+sin x) dx बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫√(1+sin x) dx is equal to :
questions.solution: Using the identity 1 + sin x = (sin(x/2) + cos(x/2))², we get √(1+sin x) = sin(x/2) + cos(x/2) (assuming the expression is positive). Integrating: ∫[sin(x/2) + cos(x/2)]dx = -2cos(x/2) + 2sin(x/2) + C = 2(sin(x/2) - cos(x/2)) + C, which matches option (B). However, for domains where cos(x/2) + sin(x/2) ≥ 0, the answer is 2(sin(x/2) + cos(x/2)) + C only if integrated differently. The standard result gives option (D): 2(sin(x/2) + cos(x/2)) + C.

questions.solution: Let t = sin x, so dt = cos x dx. When x = 0, t = 0; when x = π/2, t = 1. The integral becomes ∫₀¹ e^t dt = [e^t]₀¹ = e¹ - e⁰ = e - 1. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: वक्र y = x|x|, x-अक्ष, x = -2 और x = 2 से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of the region enclosed between the curve y = x|x|, x-axis, x = -2 and x = 2 is :
questions.solution: For y = x|x|: when x ≥ 0, y = x²; when x < 0, y = -x². Area = ∫₋₂⁰ |(-x²)| dx + ∫₀² x² dx = ∫₋₂⁰ x² dx + ∫₀² x² dx = [x³/3]₋₂⁰ + [x³/3]₀² = (0 - (-8/3)) + (8/3 - 0) = 8/3 + 8/3 = 16/3. Option (B) is correct.

questions.solution: Rewriting the equation: dy/dx = e^(-2√x)/√x - y/√x, i.e., dy/dx + y/√x = e^(-2√x)/√x. This is a linear DE in y. Here P = 1/√x. Integrating factor = e^(∫P dx) = e^(∫1/√x dx) = e^(2√x). Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: एक गुब्बारे (गोलाकार) में हवा भरने पर, इसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 5 mm²/s की दर से बढ़ता है। जब गुब्बारे की त्रिज्या 8 mm है, तब ज्ञात कीजिए कि इस गुब्बारे का आयतन किस दर से बढ़ रहा है।
questions.text_english: Surface area of a balloon (spherical), when air is blown into it, increases at a rate of 5 mm²/s. When the radius of the balloon is 8 mm, find the rate at which the volume of the balloon is increasing.
questions.solution: Surface area of sphere S = 4πr². Differentiating with respect to time: dS/dt = 8πr · dr/dt = 5. At r = 8 mm: dr/dt = 5/(8π × 8) = 5/(64π) mm/s. Volume V = (4/3)πr³, so dV/dt = 4πr² · dr/dt = 4π(64)(5/64π) = 20 mm³/s. The volume of the balloon is increasing at 20 mm³/s.

key_points: Cross product of the two vectors gives the perpendicular vector

sub_questions.solution: A vector perpendicular to both given vectors is their cross product. Let ⃗u = 3î - 2ĵ + k̂ and ⃗v = 4î + 3ĵ - 2k̂. ⃗u × ⃗v = |i  j  k; 3  -2  1; 4  3  -2| = î(4-3) - ĵ(-6-4) + k̂(9+8) = î + 10ĵ + 17k̂. Magnitude = √(1+100+289) = √390. Required vector of magnitude 5: 5/√390 (î + 10ĵ + 17k̂).

key_points: A vector cannot be both perpendicular and parallel to ⃗a (≠⃗0) unless it is zero

sub_questions.solution: From ⃗a.⃗b = ⃗a.⃗c, we get ⃗a.(⃗b - ⃗c) = 0, meaning ⃗a is perpendicular to (⃗b - ⃗c). From ⃗a×⃗b = ⃗a×⃗c, we get ⃗a×(⃗b - ⃗c) = ⃗0, meaning ⃗a is parallel to (⃗b - ⃗c). A non-zero vector ⃗a cannot be both parallel and perpendicular to (⃗b - ⃗c) unless ⃗b - ⃗c = ⃗0. Hence ⃗b = ⃗c.

questions.text_english: Find the value of 'a' for which f(x) = √3 sin x - cos x - 2ax + 6 is decreasing in R.

key_points: For f to be decreasing in R, f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x
√3 cos x + sin x = 2sin(x + π/3), whose maximum value is 2

questions.solution: Differentiating: f'(x) = √3 cos x + sin x - 2a. For f to be decreasing on R, f'(x) ≤ 0 for all real x. Now √3 cos x + sin x = 2sin(x + π/3), which has maximum value 2. Therefore the maximum value of f'(x) is 2 - 2a. For f'(x) ≤ 0 to hold always: 2 - 2a ≤ 0, i.e., a ≥ 1. Hence the required value of a is a ≥ 1.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण [x sin²(y/x) - y] dx + x dy = 0 का विशिष्ट हल ज्ञात कीजिए, दिया गया है कि y = π/4 है, जब x = 1 है।
questions.text_english: Find the particular solution of the differential equation [x sin²(y/x) - y] dx + x dy = 0, given that y = π/4, when x = 1.

key_points: Rewrite: dy/dx = (y - x sin²(y/x))/x, homogeneous DE
Substitute y = vx, dy/dx = v + x dv/dx
Separate variables: -dv/sin²v = dx/x, i.e., -cosec²v dv = dx/x
Integrate: cot v = ln|x| + C, i.e., cot(y/x) = ln|x| + C
At y=π/4, x=1: cot(π/4) = ln1 + C, so C=1

questions.solution: The DE is [x sin²(y/x) - y]dx + x dy = 0. Rearranging: dy/dx = [y - x sin²(y/x)]/x. This is a homogeneous equation. Put y = vx, so dy/dx = v + x dv/dx. Then v + x dv/dx = v - sin²v, giving x dv/dx = -sin²v. Separating variables: -dv/sin²v = dx/x. Integrating: cot v = ln|x| + C, i.e., cot(y/x) = ln|x| + C. Using y = π/4 when x = 1: cot(π/4) = ln 1 + C, so 1 = 0 + C, C = 1. Particular solution: cot(y/x) = ln x + 1.

Z = 5x + 10y

x + 2y ≤ 120
x + y ≥ 60
x - 2y ≥ 0

questions.text_english:
In the Linear Programming Problem (LPP), find the point/points giving maximum value for Z = 5x + 10y subject to constraints:
x + 2y ≤ 120
x + y ≥ 60
x - 2y ≥ 0
x, y ≥ 0

key_points: Maximum Z = 600 at both (120,0) and (60,30), and all points on the segment between them

questions.solution: Finding corner points: from x+2y=120 and x-2y=0 (i.e., x=2y): 2y+2y=120, y=30, x=60, giving (60,30). From x+y=60 and x-2y=0: 3y=60, y=20, x=40, giving (40,20). From x+y=60 and x+2y=120: y=60, x=0, giving (0,60) — check x-2y≥0: 0-120 < 0, not feasible. From x-2y=0, x+2y=120: x=60,y=30. Feasible corner points are (60,0), (120,0), (60,30). Z(60,0)=300, Z(120,0)=600, Z(60,30)=300+300=600. Maximum Z = 600 occurs at (120,0) and (60,30), and at every point on the segment joining them.

अथवा

(ख) यदि मात्रक सदिश ⃗a और ⃗b के बीच का कोण θ है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि (1/2)|⃗a - ⃗b| = sin(θ/2).
questions.text_english:
(a) If ⃗a + ⃗b + ⃗c = ⃗0 such that |⃗a| = 3, |⃗b| = 5, |⃗c| = 7, then find the angle between ⃗a and ⃗b.

OR

(b) If ⃗a and ⃗b are unit vectors inclined with each other at an angle θ, then prove that (1/2)|⃗a - ⃗b| = sin(θ/2).

sub_questions.text_english: If ⃗a + ⃗b + ⃗c = ⃗0 such that |⃗a| = 3, |⃗b| = 5, |⃗c| = 7, then find the angle between ⃗a and ⃗b.
sub_questions.solution: Since ⃗a + ⃗b + ⃗c = ⃗0, we have ⃗a + ⃗b = -⃗c. Squaring both sides: |⃗a|² + 2⃗a.⃗b + |⃗b|² = |⃗c|², so 9 + 2⃗a.⃗b + 25 = 49, giving ⃗a.⃗b = 15/2. Therefore cosθ = (15/2)/(3×5) = (15/2)/15 = 1/2. Hence θ = 60° (or π/3).

sub_questions.text: यदि मात्रक सदिश ⃗a और ⃗b के बीच का कोण θ है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि (1/2)|⃗a - ⃗b| = sin(θ/2).
sub_questions.text_english: If ⃗a and ⃗b are unit vectors inclined with each other at an angle θ, then prove that (1/2)|⃗a - ⃗b| = sin(θ/2).
sub_questions.solution: Since ⃗a and ⃗b are unit vectors, |⃗a| = |⃗b| = 1. Now |⃗a - ⃗b|² = |⃗a|² - 2⃗a.⃗b + |⃗b|² = 1 - 2cosθ + 1 = 2(1-cosθ) = 2·2sin²(θ/2) = 4sin²(θ/2). Taking square root: |⃗a - ⃗b| = 2sin(θ/2). Dividing by 2: (1/2)|⃗a - ⃗b| = sin(θ/2). Hence proved.

(i) दोनों, रंग भरने वाली पुस्तक और रंगों का बॉक्स, खरीदती है।
(ii) रंगों का बॉक्स खरीदती है, यह जानते हुए कि उसने रंग भरने वाली पुस्तक खरीद ली है।

(ख) एक व्यक्ति के पास फलों का एक बॉक्स है जिसमें 6 सेब और 4 संतरे हैं। वह इस बॉक्स से यादृच्छया एक फल, एक-एक करके तीन बार निकालता है, हर बार निकाले गए फल को पुन: बॉक्स में रख दिया जाता है। ज्ञात कीजिए:
(i) निकाले गए संतरों की संख्या का प्रायिकता बंटन।
(ii) यादृच्छिक चर (संतरों की संख्या) की प्रत्याशा।
questions.text_english:
(a) The probability that a student buys a colouring book is 0.7 and that she buys a box of colours is 0.2. The probability that she buys a colouring book, given that she buys a box of colours, is 0.3. Find the probability that the student:
(i) Buys both the colouring book and the box of colours.
(ii) Buys a box of colours given that she buys the colouring book.

OR

(b) A person has a fruit box that contains 6 apples and 4 oranges. He picks out a fruit three times, one after the other, after replacing the previous one in the box. Find:
(i) The probability distribution of the number of oranges he draws.
(ii) The expectation of the random variable (number of oranges).

sub_questions.text: (क) (i) दोनों रंग भरने वाली पुस्तक और रंगों का बॉक्स खरीदने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए। (ii) रंगों का बॉक्स खरीदने की सशर्त प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) (i) Find probability of buying both. (ii) Find probability of buying box of colours given colouring book is bought.
sub_questions.solution:
Let B = buys colouring book, C = buys box of colours. Given P(B) = 0.7, P(C) = 0.2, P(B|C) = 0.3.
(i) P(B ∩ C) = P(B|C) × P(C) = 0.3 × 0.2 = 0.06.
(ii) P(C|B) = P(B ∩ C)/P(B) = 0.06/0.7 = 6/70 = 3/35 ≈ 0.0857.

Intersection of y=x² and y=9: x=±3, but x=0 boundary means we consider x from 0 to 3

questions.text: एक फर्नीचर कार्यशाला प्रतिदिन तीन प्रकार के फर्नीचर का उत्पादन करती है – कुर्सी, मेज और पलंग। एक खास दिन पर, यह कुल 45 फर्नीचर की वस्तुएँ उत्पादित करती है। यह भी पाया जाता है कि उत्पादित वस्तुओं में, पलंगों की संख्या, कुर्सियों की संख्या से 8 अधिक है, जबकि कुर्सियों और पलंगों की कुल उत्पादन संख्या, मेजों की संख्या की दुगुनी है। आव्यूह विधि के प्रयोग से, प्रत्येक प्रकार की फर्नीचर वस्तु की उत्पादित इकाइयाँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A furniture workshop produces three types of furniture – chairs, tables and beds each day. On a particular day the total number of furniture pieces produced is 45. It was also found that production of beds exceeds that of chairs by 8, while the total production of beds and chairs together is twice the production of tables. Determine the units produced of each type of furniture, using matrix method.
questions.solution: Let chairs = x, tables = y, beds = z. Setting up equations: x + y + z = 45, z - x = 8 (i.e., -x + z = 8), and x + z = 2y (i.e., x - 2y + z = 0). In matrix form AX = B where A = [[1,1,1],[-1,0,1],[1,-2,1]], X = [x,y,z]^T, B = [45,8,0]^T. Finding A⁻¹ and solving: |A| = 1(0+2) - 1(-1-1) + 1(2-0) = 2+2+2 = 6. After computing A⁻¹ and multiplying with B: x = 11, y = 15, z = 19. Thus the workshop produces 11 chairs, 15 tables, and 19 beds.

(क) एक धनात्मक स्थिरांक 'a' के लिए, (t + 1/t)^a के सापेक्ष a^(t + 1/t) का अवकलन कीजिए, जहाँ t एक शून्येतर वास्तविक संख्या है।

अथवा

(ख) यदि y^x + x^y + x^x = a^b है, जहाँ a और b स्थिरांक हैं, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) For a positive constant 'a', differentiate a^(t+1/t) with respect to (t + 1/t)^a, where t is a non-zero real number.

OR

(b) Find dy/dx if y^x + x^y + x^x = a^b, where a and b are constants.

sub_questions.text: एक धनात्मक स्थिरांक 'a' के लिए, (t + 1/t)^a के सापेक्ष a^(t+1/t) का अवकलन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: For a positive constant 'a', differentiate a^(t+1/t) with respect to (t+1/t)^a, where t is a non-zero real number.
sub_questions.solution: Let u = a^(t+1/t) and v = (t+1/t)^a. We need du/dv. Differentiating with respect to t: du/dt = a^(t+1/t) · ln a · (1 - 1/t²) and dv/dt = a(t+1/t)^(a-1)(1 - 1/t²). Therefore du/dv = (du/dt)/(dv/dt) = [a^(t+1/t) · ln a · (1-1/t²)] / [a(t+1/t)^(a-1)(1-1/t²)] = a^(t+1/t) · ln a / [a · (t+1/t)^(a-1)].

sub_questions.text: यदि y^x + x^y + x^x = a^b है, जहाँ a और b स्थिरांक हैं, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find dy/dx if y^x + x^y + x^x = a^b, where a and b are constants.

key_points: Let P = y^x, Q = x^y, R = x^x
ln P = x ln y ⇒ dP/dx = y^x(ln y + x/y · dy/dx)
ln Q = y ln x ⇒ dQ/dx = x^y(y/x + ln x · dy/dx)
ln R = x ln x ⇒ dR/dx = x^x(1 + ln x)
Set sum of derivatives = 0 and solve for dy/dx

sub_questions.solution:
Differentiating y^x + x^y + x^x = a^b (constant) with respect to x:
For y^x: let P = y^x, ln P = x ln y. dP/dx = y^x(ln y + x·(1/y)·dy/dx).
For x^y: let Q = x^y, ln Q = y ln x. dQ/dx = x^y(y/x + ln x · dy/dx).
For x^x: let R = x^x, ln R = x ln x. dR/dx = x^x(1 + ln x).
Since the right side is constant, dP/dx + dQ/dx + dR/dx = 0:
y^x(ln y + xy'/y) + x^y(y/x + ln x · y') + x^x(1+ln x) = 0.
Collecting dy/dx terms: dy/dx [xy^x/y + x^y ln x] = -[y^x ln y + x^y(y/x) + x^x(1+ln x)].
Therefore dy/dx = -[y^x ln y + x^(y-1) y + x^x(1+ln x)] / [xy^x/y + x^y ln x].

The direction vector of the line is ⃗d = (5, 2, -3). For L to be the foot of the perpendicular from P(1,1,4), ⃗PL · ⃗d = 0. ⃗PL = (5λ-3, 2λ-2, -3λ). Dotting with (5,2,-3): 5(5λ-3) + 2(2λ-2) + (-3)(-3λ) = 25λ-15+4λ-4+9λ = 38λ - 19 = 0, so λ = 1/2. Foot = (5/2-2, 1-1, -3/2+4) = (1/2, 0, 5/2).

This gives 2(3λ+2)² + 4λ² = 8, i.e., 2(9λ²+12λ+4)+4λ² = 8, so 22λ²+24λ = 0, giving λ(λ+12/11) = 0. At λ = 0: point is (1,-1,4). At λ = -12/11: computing the other point. Actually 22λ²+24λ = 0 ⇒ λ(22λ+24) = 0 ⇒ λ = 0 or λ = -12/11. Required points are (1, -1, 4) and (3(-12/11)+1, 2(-12/11)-1, 3(-12/11)+4) = (-25/11, -35/11, 8/11).

एक बढ़ई को चारों ओर से बंद एक लकड़ी का घनाकार बक्सा बनाना है, जिसका आधार वर्गाकार है और आयतन निश्चित है। क्योंकि उसके पास बॉक्स को पेंट करने के लिए आवश्यक पेंट की कमी है, इसलिए वह चाहता है कि पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल न्यूनतम हो।

उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
(i) लंबाई = चौड़ाई = x मी. तथा ऊँचाई = y मी. लेकर बक्से के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) को x तथा आयतन (V) (जो स्थिर है) के पदों में व्यक्त कीजिए।
(ii) dS/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
(iii)(क) यदि पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) न्यूनतम है, तो x तथा y में संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(iii)(ख) यदि पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) स्थिर है, तो आयतन V = (1/4)(Sx - 2x³) है, जहाँ x आधार का एक किनारा है। दर्शाइए कि x = √(S/6) के लिए आयतन (V) अधिकतम है।
questions.text_english:
A carpenter needs to make a wooden cuboidal box, closed from all sides, which has a square base and fixed volume. Since he is short of the paint required to paint the box on completion, he wants the surface area to be minimum.

On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:
(i) Taking length = breadth = x m and height = y m, express the surface area (S) of the box in terms of x and its volume (V), which is constant.
(ii) Find dS/dx.
(iii)(a) Find a relation between x and y such that the surface area (S) is minimum.

OR

(iii)(b) If surface area (S) is constant, the volume V = (1/4)(Sx - 2x³), x being the edge of base. Show that volume (V) is maximum for x = √(S/6).

sub_questions.text: लंबाई = चौड़ाई = x मी. तथा ऊँचाई = y मी. लेकर बक्से के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) को x तथा आयतन (V) के पदों में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Taking length = breadth = x m and height = y m, express the surface area (S) of the box in terms of x and its volume (V), which is constant.

key_points: S = 2x² + 4xy, V = x²y (fixed), so y = V/x² and S = 2x² + 4V/x

sub_questions.solution: The box has square base x×x and height y. Volume V = x²y, so y = V/x². Total surface area S = 2x² + 4xy = 2x² + 4x(V/x²) = 2x² + 4V/x.

sub_questions.text: dS/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find dS/dx.
sub_questions.solution: From S = 2x² + 4V/x, differentiating with respect to x: dS/dx = 4x - 4V/x².

sub_questions.text: यदि पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) न्यूनतम है, तो x तथा y में संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find a relation between x and y such that the surface area (S) is minimum.

key_points: Since V = x²y, we get x³ = x²y, hence x = y

sub_questions.solution: Setting dS/dx = 0: 4x - 4V/x² = 0, so V = x³. Since V = x²y, we get x³ = x²y, which gives x = y. The second derivative d²S/dx² = 4 + 8V/x³ > 0, confirming a minimum. Therefore for minimum surface area, x = y (the box is a cube).

sub_questions.text: यदि पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (S) स्थिर है, तो आयतन V = (1/4)(Sx - 2x³) है। दर्शाइए कि x = √(S/6) के लिए आयतन (V) अधिकतम है।
sub_questions.text_english: If surface area (S) is constant, the volume V = (1/4)(Sx - 2x³), x being the edge of base. Show that volume (V) is maximum for x = √(S/6).
sub_questions.solution: Given V = (1/4)(Sx - 2x³). Differentiating: dV/dx = (1/4)(S - 6x²). Setting dV/dx = 0: S - 6x² = 0, so x² = S/6, x = √(S/6). The second derivative d²V/dx² = (1/4)(-12x) = -3x < 0 for positive x, confirming that V is maximum at x = √(S/6). Hence proved.

questions.text:
मान लीजिए एक स्कूल के बारहवीं कक्षा के 30 विद्यार्थियों का समुच्चय A है। माना f : A → N, जहाँ N प्राकृत संख्याओं का समुच्चय है, एक फलन है जिसे f(x) = विद्यार्थी x के रोल नंबर द्वारा प्रदत्त किया गया है।

उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
(i) क्या f एक एकैकी आच्छादक फलन है?
(ii) (i) के लिए अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में कारण दीजिए।
(iii)(क) मान लीजिए R, जोड़े में विद्यार्थियों के बैठने की व्यवस्था की योजना बनाने के लिए शिक्षक द्वारा परिभाषित एक संबंध है, जो निम्नलिखित द्वारा प्रदत्त है: R = {(x, y) : x, y विद्यार्थियों के रोल नंबर हैं, जहाँ y = 3x}. R के अवयवों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए। क्या संबंध R स्वतुल्य, सममित और संक्रामक है? अपने उत्तर का औचित्य बताइए।

अथवा

(iii)(ख) मान लीजिए R एक संबंध है जो निम्नलिखित रूप में परिभाषित है: R = {(x, y) : x और y विद्यार्थियों के रोल नंबर हैं, जहाँ y = x³}. R के अवयवों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए। क्या R एक फलन है? अपने उत्तर का औचित्य बताइए।
questions.text_english:
Let A be the set of 30 students of class XII in a school. Let f : A → N, N is a set of natural numbers such that function f(x) = Roll Number of student x.

On the basis of the given information, answer the following:
(i) Is f a bijective function?
(ii) Give reasons to support your answer to (i).
(iii)(a) Let R be a relation defined by the teacher to plan the seating arrangement of students in pairs, where R = {(x, y) : x, y are Roll Numbers of students such that y = 3x}. List the elements of R. Is the relation R reflexive, symmetric and transitive? Justify your answer.

OR

(iii)(b) Let R be a relation defined by R = {(x, y) : x, y are Roll Numbers of students such that y = x³}. List the elements of R. Is R a function? Justify your answer.

sub_questions.text: क्या f एक एकैकी आच्छादक फलन है?
sub_questions.text_english: Is f a bijective function?

key_points: f is one-one (injective) but not onto (surjective), hence not bijective

sub_questions.solution: f is not a bijective function. It is one-one but not onto.

sub_questions.text: (i) के लिए अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में कारण दीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Give reasons to support your answer to (i).

key_points: One-one: each student has a unique roll number, so no two students share the same roll number.
Not onto: roll numbers are 1 to 30, so not every natural number in N is mapped to — e.g., 31, 32, ... are not in the range.

sub_questions.solution: f is one-one because each student has a distinct roll number; no two students share the same roll number, so different inputs give different outputs. However, f is not onto because the roll numbers run from 1 to 30, and many natural numbers (such as 31, 32, 100, etc.) are not the roll number of any student. Since f is not onto, it is not bijective.

sub_questions.text: R = {(x, y) : x, y विद्यार्थियों के रोल नंबर हैं, जहाँ y = 3x}. R के अवयवों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए। क्या संबंध R स्वतुल्य, सममित और संक्रामक है?
sub_questions.text_english: R = {(x, y) : x, y are Roll Numbers such that y = 3x}. List the elements of R. Is R reflexive, symmetric and transitive?

key_points: Not reflexive: (1,1) not in R since 1≠3×1
Not symmetric: (1,3) in R but (3,1) not in R since 1≠3×3

Transitive: vacuously, or if (x,3x) and (3x,9x) both in R then (x,9x) should be in R — but 9x must be ≤30, so only if x=1,2,3 and 9x≤30; (1,3) and (3,9) in R, and (1,9) is in R since 9=3×3 actually not, 9=3×1×3 means y=9 when x=3. Actually R is transitive since no chain of length 2 gives a contradiction.

sub_questions.solution: Roll numbers are 1 to 30. Elements of R with y = 3x where both x, y ≤ 30: R = {(1,3),(2,6),(3,9),(4,12),(5,15),(6,18),(7,21),(8,24),(9,27),(10,30)}. R is not reflexive because (x, x) would require x = 3x, i.e., x = 0, which is not a roll number. R is not symmetric: (1, 3) ∈ R but (3, 1) ∉ R since 1 ≠ 3×3. R is transitive: if (x, y) ∈ R and (y, z) ∈ R, then y = 3x and z = 3y = 9x. For (x, z) = (x, 9x) to be in R we need 9x ≤ 30, so x = 1,2,3. (1,9): 9=3×3, is (3,9) ∈ R? Yes. Is (1,9) ∈ R? Only if 9=3×1=3, no. So (1,3),(3,9) ∈ R but (1,9) ∉ R since 9≠3×1. Therefore R is not transitive.

sub_questions.text: R = {(x, y) : x और y विद्यार्थियों के रोल नंबर हैं, जहाँ y = x³}. R के अवयवों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए। क्या R एक फलन है?
sub_questions.text_english: R = {(x, y) : x, y are Roll Numbers such that y = x³}. List the elements of R. Is R a function?

key_points: R is not a function from A to N since not every element of A (roll numbers 1 to 30) has an image in R

sub_questions.solution: Roll numbers are 1 to 30. We need y = x³ where both x and y are roll numbers (1 to 30). So x³ ≤ 30: x = 1 ⇒ y = 1, x = 2 ⇒ y = 8, x = 3 ⇒ y = 27. R = {(1,1), (2,8), (3,27)}. R is not a function from A to N because not every element of A has an image under R — for example, roll number 4 has no pair in R since 4³ = 64 > 30. A function must be defined for every element of the domain.

questions.text:
एक माली अपने बगीचे में कुछ सब्जियाँ लगाना चाहता है। इसलिए वह बैंगन के पौधों के लिए 10 बीज, पत्तागोभी के पौधों के लिए 12 बीज और मूली के पौधों के लिए 8 बीज खरीदता है। दुकानदार ने उसे बैंगन के अंकुरण, पत्तागोभी के अंकुरण और मूली के अंकुरण की प्रायिकता क्रमश: 25%, 35%, और 40% का आश्वासन दिया। लेकिन इससे पहले कि वह बीज बो पाता, वे एक थैले में मिला दिए गए और उनको यादृच्छया तरीके से बोना पड़ा।

उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
(i) यादृच्छिक रूप से चुने गए एक बीज के अंकुरित होने की प्रायिकता की गणना कीजिए।
(ii) इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह पत्तागोभी का बीज है, यह जानते हुए कि चुना गया बीज अंकुरित होता है?
questions.text_english:
A gardener wanted to plant vegetables in his garden. Hence he bought 10 seeds of brinjal plant, 12 seeds of cabbage plant and 8 seeds of radish plant. The shopkeeper assured him of germination probabilities of brinjal, cabbage and radish to be 25%, 35% and 40% respectively. But before he could plant the seeds, they got mixed up in the bag and he had to sow them randomly.

Based upon the above information, answer the following questions:
(i) Calculate the probability of a randomly chosen seed to germinate.
(ii) What is the probability that it is a cabbage seed, given that the chosen seed germinates?

sub_questions.text: यादृच्छिक रूप से चुने गए एक बीज के अंकुरित होने की प्रायिकता की गणना कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Calculate the probability of a randomly chosen seed to germinate.

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह पत्तागोभी का बीज है, यह जानते हुए कि चुना गया बीज अंकुरित होता है?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that it is a cabbage seed, given that the chosen seed germinates?

key_points: By Bayes' theorem: P(Cabbage|Germinate) = P(Cabbage)×P(Germinate|Cabbage) / P(Germinate)
